titleEn: Ensuite Bathroom Renovation in Richmond 2026: Real Cost, Design & What to Expect
titleZh: 列治文主卧浴室装修2026：真实费用、设计方案及注意事项
contentEn:
An ensuite bathroom renovation in Richmond costs $12,000 to $45,000 in 2026, depending on whether the scope is a cosmetic refresh or a full re-plumb to the studs. The defining difference is whether you are replacing a framed glass shower enclosure or removing a combined bathtub-shower and installing a curbless walk-in shower — the latter requires drainage work that triggers a City of Richmond building permit and a licensed plumber. Reno Stars' portfolio includes an ensuite renovation in Richmond completed as part of a whole-home project where the original 1980s framed shower was demolished, asbestos-containing wall tile was removed under certified abatement, and the space was rebuilt with a walk-in shower with black-framed sliding glass, marble-look wall tile, a wood-tone vanity and matte-black hardware.

What does an ensuite renovation cost in Richmond in 2026

Ensuite renovation costs in Richmond in 2026 fall into three tiers based on scope:

  • Cosmetic refresh — new vanity, faucet, toilet, mirror, paint and flooring: $12,000 to $22,000. The existing shower or bathtub enclosure is not touched. No plumbing permit required unless the toilet is relocated.
  • Shower replacement — remove the old framed glass enclosure and install a new walk-in shower with tile, glass door, shower pan and plumbing modifications: $22,000 to $35,000. This scope requires a City of Richmond building permit and a licensed plumber for any drain line work. A walk-in shower with a black-framed sliding glass door typically adds $800 to $2,500 for the door alone, installed. Marble-look porcelain or ceramic wall tile runs $8 to $25 per square foot installed.
  • Full re-plumb to the studs — remove all existing bathroom fixtures, demo to the studs, reroute drain lines and water supply, install new subfloor, tile, vanity, toilet, shower and exhaust: $35,000 to $45,000+. This scope requires a full building permit, a structural assessment if walls are being removed, and certified asbestos abatement if the home was built before 1990.

Do you need a building permit for an ensuite renovation in Richmond

It depends on the scope. A cosmetic refresh — replacing a vanity, faucet and toilet without relocating any plumbing — does not require a building permit in Richmond. Replacing a framed shower enclosure with a walk-in shower typically requires a building permit if the drain line is moved, the shower pan is replaced, or any wet wall is modified. Converting a combined bathtub-shower unit to a dedicated walk-in shower always requires a building permit because it changes the plumbing configuration. Reno Stars pulls the permit as the general contractor on full-scope projects; the homeowner is not responsible for managing the application. Permit fees in the City of Richmond for a bathroom renovation range from $500 to $2,000 depending on the construction value declared.

How long does an ensuite renovation take in Richmond

A cosmetic ensuite refresh in Richmond takes 2 to 3 weeks from material selection to handover. A shower replacement takes 4 to 6 weeks, with 1 to 2 weeks for permit processing if required. A full re-plumb to the studs takes 8 to 12 weeks, with permit processing taking 3 to 6 weeks of that. The City of Richmond's residential building permit queue was running 2 to 4 weeks as of mid-2026 for standard bathroom additions and alterations.

Design choices that define an ensuite renovation in 2026

Two finishes dominate ensuite renovations in Richmond in 2026. The first is a black-framed sliding glass door paired with marble-look porcelain tile on the walls and a linear drain at the shower threshold — Reno Stars installed this combination on a Richmond whole-home renovation in 2024-2025. The second is a frameless glass panel with a bench seat and hand-shower, preferred in smaller ensuites where a swinging door would reduce usable floor space. A wood-tone double vanity with matte-black hardware is the most common cabinet finish specified in Richmond ensuite projects in 2025 and 2026, replacing the chrome and oak combination that was standard in the 2010s.

FAQ: Ensuite Bathroom Renovation in Richmond

What is the average cost of an ensuite renovation in Richmond in 2026?

An ensuite bathroom renovation in Richmond costs $12,000 to $45,000 in 2026 depending on scope. A cosmetic refresh with new vanity, faucet and toilet runs $12,000 to $22,000. A walk-in shower replacement with tile, glass and plumbing modifications runs $22,000 to $35,000. A full re-plumb to the studs including certified asbestos abatement runs $35,000 to $45,000 or more.

Does an ensuite renovation in Richmond require a building permit?

A cosmetic ensuite refresh in Richmond — replacing vanity, faucet and toilet without moving plumbing — does not require a permit. Replacing a shower enclosure with a walk-in shower typically requires a permit if the drain line or shower pan is modified. Converting a bathtub-shower to a walk-in shower always requires a permit and a licensed plumber. Reno Stars manages the permit application as the general contractor.

How long does an ensuite renovation take in Richmond?

A cosmetic ensuite refresh takes 2 to 3 weeks. A shower replacement takes 4 to 6 weeks including permit processing time. A full re-plumb to the studs takes 8 to 12 weeks. The City of Richmond's residential building permit queue for bathroom alterations was running 2 to 4 weeks as of mid-2026.

What is the most popular ensuite design in Richmond in 2026?

The most specified ensuite design in Richmond in 2026 combines a walk-in shower with a black-framed sliding glass door, marble-look porcelain wall tile, a wood-tone double vanity, and matte-black hardware. This finish combination is visible in Reno Stars' completed Richmond projects and reflects the shift away from chrome-and-oak finishes that dominated 2010s bathroom renovations.

Are asbestos inspections required for ensuite renovations in Richmond?

If the ensuite is in a home built before 1990, a certified asbestos assessment is required before demo begins in British Columbia. If asbestos-containing materials are found, certified abatement must be completed before any structural demo work. Reno Stars includes this assessment in the scope for pre-1990 homes and coordinates the abatement with a licensed asbestos removal contractor before demo begins.

列治文主卧浴室装修在2026年的费用为12,000至45,000加元，具体取决于是基础翻新还是水管全面重铺。核心区别在于原有框式玻璃淋浴间是否保留，还是拆除 combined bathtub-shower 并安装无门槛步入式淋浴间——后者涉及排水工程，需要办理列治文市建筑许可证并聘请持牌水管工。聚星装修项目组合中包含一个列治文主卧浴室装修案例，原有1980年代框式淋浴间被拆除，含石棉墙砖经认证处理后清除，空间重建为步入式淋浴间，配备黑框滑动玻璃门、仿大理石纹墙砖、木纹台面浴室柜和哑光黑五金配件。

2026年列治文主卧浴室装修费用明细

2026年列治文主卧浴室装修费用按工程范围分三个档次：

  • 基础翻新 — 更换浴室柜、水龙头、马桶、镜子、油漆和地板：12,000至22,000加元。现有淋浴间或浴缸保留不动。除非马桶移位，否则无需水管许可证。
  • 淋浴间更换 — 拆除旧框式玻璃淋浴间，安装新步入式淋浴间（含瓷砖、玻璃门、淋浴盘和管道改造）：22,000至35,000加元。此工程范围需办理列治文市建筑许可证，任何排水管线工程需由持牌水管工施工。步入式淋浴间配黑框滑动玻璃门仅门一项通常增加800至2,500加元（含安装）。仿大理石纹陶瓷墙砖含安装每平方英尺8至25加元。
  • 水管全面重铺至基层 — 拆除所有现有浴室设施，基层开敞装修，重铺排水管和供水管线，安装新地板、瓷砖、浴室柜、马桶、淋浴间和排气扇：35,000至45,000加元以上。此工程范围需全面建筑许可证，若涉及墙体拆除还需结构评估，1990年前建造的住宅需进行认证石棉检测和处理。

列治文主卧浴室装修需要建筑许可证吗

取决于工程范围。基础翻新（不移动管道的情况下更换浴室柜、水龙头和马桶）无需建筑许可证。原有框式淋浴间改造为步入式淋浴间若涉及排水管线移动、淋浴盘更换或湿墙改造，通常需要许可证。将浴缸淋浴 combined 转换为专用步入式淋浴间因涉及管道配置变更，强制要求许可证。聚星装修作为总承包商代理申请许可证；业主无需自行管理申请流程。列治文市浴室装修工程许可证费用根据申报工程价值，约为500至2,000加元。

列治文主卧浴室装修需要多长时间

列治文基础主卧浴室翻新从材料选定到交付约需2至3周。淋浴间更换约需4至6周（含许可证办理时间，如需申请）。水管全面重铺至基层约需8至12周，其中许可证办理占3至6周。截至2026年年中，列治文市民用建筑许可证浴室新建及改建队列约2至4周。

2026年主卧浴室装修的关键设计选择

2026年列治文主卧浴室装修两大主流风格：第一种是黑框滑动玻璃门配仿大理石纹陶瓷墙砖，淋浴间门槛设线性地漏——聚星装修在2024-2025年列治文全屋装修项目中采用了这一组合。第二种是无框玻璃面板配坐凳和手持花洒，更适合小型主卧浴室（摆门会减少可用地面空间）。木纹双人浴室柜配哑光黑五金是2025年和2026年列治文主卧浴室项目中最高频指定的柜体饰面，取代了2010年代标准的镀铬+橡木组合。

FAQ：列治文主卧浴室装修

2026年列治文主卧浴室装修平均费用是多少？

2026年列治文主卧浴室装修费用为12,000至45,000加元，视工程范围而定。基础翻新（更换浴室柜、水龙头和马桶）费用12,000至22,000加元。步入式淋浴间更换（含瓷砖、玻璃和管道改造）费用22,000至35,000加元。水管全面重铺至基层（含认证石棉处理）费用35,000加元以上。

列治文主卧浴室装修需要建筑许可证吗？

列治文基础主卧浴室翻新（不移动管道的情况下更换浴室柜、水龙头和马桶）无需许可证。将框式淋浴间改造为步入式淋浴间若涉及排水管线或淋浴盘改造，通常需要许可证。将浴缸淋浴 combined 转换为步入式淋浴间强制要求许可证并需持牌水管工。聚星装修作为总承包商代理管理许可证申请。

列治文主卧浴室装修需要多长时间？

基础翻新约2至3周。淋浴间更换约4至6周（含许可证办理时间）。水管全面重铺至基层约8至12周。截至2026年年中，列治文市民用建筑许可证浴室改建队列约2至4周。

2026年列治文最受欢迎的主卧浴室设计是什么？

2026年列治文最高频指定的主卧浴室设计组合：步入式淋浴间配黑框滑动玻璃门、仿大理石纹陶瓷墙砖、木纹双人浴室柜和哑光黑五金配件。这一饰面组合在聚星装修已完成的列治文项目中可见，体现了相对于2010年代镀铬+橡木组合的趋势转变。

列治文主卧浴室装修需要石棉检测吗？

若主卧浴室位于1990年前建造的住宅，在不列颠哥伦比亚省，拆除工程开始前必须进行认证石棉评估。若检出含石棉材料，必须由认证石棉清除承包商完成清除后方可进行任何结构拆除工程。聚星装修将1990年前住宅的此项评估纳入工程范围，并在拆除前协调认证石棉清除工作。
